Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. Only one or two small gripes; the piezoelectric lighting process does not always light the gas immediately, so I have to be careful not to fill the compartment with gas. I have had a couple larger combustions and am more careful now. Gripe 2: the temp is very high if all three burners are going at the same time, and getting it to produce 350-400 degree heat can be tricky, esp if you start too high. You basically have to start with one or two burners, nudge it here and there, and give it time to get to where you need it, or you will overdo it and have to come back down.
Results.Title: Great grill, two points to consider

Results.ReviewText: There are two reasons for the downgrade from 5 stars.  First, I cannot get the grill to cook at a temperature below 300 degrees.  I enjoy slow cooking and using the smoking box but temperature is too high.  Second, I followed the YouTube video for cleaning the grill and found there are too many places inside where grease accumulates.  I am hesitant to use a high-pressure hose and have thought about buying a handheld steamer.  Otherwise, I live cooking on the grill, steaks, chicken, ribs, and vegetables are always perfect.
Results.Title: Great Grill for the Price but...

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
